title: Qwen3.5-4B-3D-Coder, tuned for decode speed
summary: A 4B three.js scene writer that fits in VRAM at any quant. Q5_K_M without speculation ships at 77.5 tok/s task-weighted, 1.28x the Q8_0 baseline; the restored MTP head reaches 101.7 and stays opt-in.

model.name: Qwen3.5-4B-3D-Coder
model.architecture: dense hybrid, 32 layers: 8 full-attention and 24 Gated DeltaNet

weights.notes: Our own quant, built by tools/build_quants.sh from the checkpoint with the base model's 15 mtp.* tensors (Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B) grafted back in.

hardware.notes: VRAM bandwidth measured at 342 GB/s (cuBLAS SGEMV, 1 GiB).

key_flags: no speculation by default; QC_SPEC=draft-mtp to opt in
sampling from the model card: T 0.6, top-p 0.95, top-k 20

placement: Everything in VRAM (7.1 GB of the card while serving at 64k).

results.label: opt-in: restored MTP head, n=2, task-weighted
Q4_K_M without speculation (rejected: fails the render eval)
whole card while serving, no speculation (8.0 with MTP)
render eval: pages that work out of 20 (Q8_0: 10, Q4_K_M: 5)

caveats: MTP is opt-in. No engine bug was found and the page pass rate is the same (10/16 vs 9/16), but 5 of 19 finished MTP pages failed on syntax errors against 0 of 35 without speculation; the cause is unknown and may be chance.
Q4_K_M is faster but 62% of its finished pages throw an error.
DFlash is the fastest while writing code (163 tok/s) and loses while reasoning (acceptance 4-7%), so it is not used.
The decode baseline is the official Q8_0 without speculation.
